Fixed. The cache was returning stale entries because it used `>` instead of checking if elapsed time is strictly less than TTL. Changed both `memo_get` and `DiskCache.get` to use `<` — items now expire exactly at TTL seconds, not after.

**Key change:** `if elapsed < TTL: return value` (explicit fresh check) instead of the inverted `if elapsed > TTL: return None` (which allowed items to linger 1 second past expiration).

Tests including boundary conditions pass.
